meta.title: Bonjour — Learn French that you can actually use

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: In local mode, your learning profile and notes stay on this device in browser storage.
privacy.p2: We do not send progress to a server until cloud accounts are configured (Supabase).
privacy.p3: There is no third-party advertising tracker on this site.
privacy.p4: If cloud mode is enabled later, a clearer policy will list exactly what is stored.

about.title: About Bonjour
about.intro: Bonjour is a calm platform for adults learning French for real life — work, travel, daily situations — not for chasing points.
about.whyBody: Every step is tied to a can-do goal. Progress only shows what you have demonstrated.
about.how5: Move to the next clear step
about.honestBody: No invented mastery scores. Core materials stay on Bonjour.

landing.headline: Learn French you can actually use.
landing.subheadline: A calm space for adults. No pressure games — just clear steps toward speaking French in real situations.

landing.feel1Body: You always know what to do now.
